scripts.text:
[Necko]
I'm sorry. Necko's store is...
Oh? Who's this?
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Long time no see!
How are you?
Nice to see you again!!
Anything new?
Wow~ I'm so glad to see you!
You! Stop by once in a while!
I might forget what you look like!
Pukakakakakakakakaka!!!
Very very nice to see you!!
It's so nice to see you like this!
Come to Alberta often!
Killing two birds with one stone!!
I get to see you, and shout also!!
How much better can it get!!!
Keuhahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Ppyakikakikakakakakakakaka!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
抱歉，涅科的店...
哦？誰來了？
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
好久不見！
最近怎麼樣？
又見到你真高興！！
有什麼新鮮事？
哇~太開心了！
你呀，偶爾也過來轉轉！
不然我都快忘了你長什麼樣了！
Pukakakakakakakakaka!!!
真是太、太高興了！！
能這樣再見面，真好！
常來艾爾貝塔啊！
一舉兩得！！
既見著你，又能放聲喊！！
還有比這更棒的嗎！！！
Keuhahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Ppyakikakikakakakakakakaka!!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, did you come because
you are infatuated with my voice?
My voice is loud, isn't it!
considering you can hear it from a distance.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，被我的嗓音迷住了？
嗓門夠響吧，離那麼遠都聽得見！
而且啊...
（四下張望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't just loud!
!
Once you are about a level 15 merchant
I will tell you the secret!
Then, come again!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的聲音可不只是響亮！！
等你當商人練到15級，就告訴你秘密！
到時候再來！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Uahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Kyukwakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
Uahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Kyukwakakakakakakakakakaka!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh! You!
You are qualified to learn how to shout!
Learn how to shout with my help.
Would you like to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，是你！
可以學怎麼喊了！
我來教你，想學大聲吶喊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!!!!
scripts.translation: 我要學

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Ahahahahaha!! Good!!!
That's the spirit!
Here we go!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
Ahahahahaha!! 好！！！
就是這股勁兒！
開始！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You have learned Crazy Uproar!!
Shout as much as you wish!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
學會大聲吶喊了！！
盡情喊吧！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Eh... ok.
Pooooh...
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
呃...好吧。
Pooooh...

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 SP, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point on.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大聲吶喊靠響亮的聲音振奮鬥志。
消耗8 SP，力量提高4點，持續5分鐘！！！！！
再次使用，就從那一刻重新計算5分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
and when you need to fight
it will gather your spirit.
Very useful, I must say!!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平時輕輕鬆鬆，打起仗來，就靠它凝聚鬥志。
好用得很！！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, were you charmed 
by my voice?
Indeed, my voice is loud!
You can hear it from so far away.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，被我的嗓音迷住了？
那當然，我嗓門可大了，隔老遠都聽得見！
而且啊...
（四下張望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't JUST loud!
I have learned the skill
that lets me shout..
The Crazy Uproar skill!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的聲音可不只是響亮！
我學過專門用來吶喊的絕技...大聲吶喊！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 sp, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大聲吶喊靠響亮的聲音振奮鬥志。
消耗8 SP，力量提高4點，持續5分鐘！！！！！
再次使用，就從那一刻重新計算5分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
but shout to gather more
strength when you fight.
It is very useful!!!!
To learn this skill, you first need
to learn the essentials of sound!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平時輕輕鬆鬆，戰鬥時放聲吶喊，就能凝聚更多力量。
好用得很！！！！
想學這招，先得懂聲音的基本功！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You can learn this in Payon
from a singer with just a loud voice
You can take lessons from him!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
斐揚有個嗓門特別大的歌手，可以教你。
找他上課就行！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
But that person died!
So you can't learn it anymore!
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
..............................
...Aww you look disappointed?
Do you want to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
不過，那人已經死了！
沒處學啦！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!!!!
...
...哎呀，失望了？
想學大聲吶喊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Hmm... Shall I teach you?
If you really want it, that is.
First, I must scorch the vocal cords.
There are some things needed to do so.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
嗯...真想學的話，我來教你？
先得燒灼聲帶，為此要準備點東西。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
7 Pearls, 1 bottle of Banana Juice,
and 50 mushroom spores!
Then I'll scorch your vocal chord!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
珍珠7顆
香蕉汁1瓶
香菇芽孢50個
帶齊了，就來燒灼聲帶！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
See you when you are ready!
I shall prepare my throat for then as well!!
Bboowuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh~~~!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
準備好了再來！
我也先養好嗓子！！
Bboowuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh~~~!!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Necko's store is closed right now.
come again later. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
涅科的店鋪現在關門了。
請稍後再來。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[!?]
Muahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[！？]
Muahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakakakakaka!

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm? I was wondering who was making all
the raucus carrying around a cart.
It was you.
Yes, I remember you.
what do you think? The new cart..good, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
嗯？我還在想，誰推著車這麼吵，原來是你。
對，記得你。
新手推車怎麼樣...不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Enjoy life.
Life isn't just simply moving
forward..Slowly, looking around,
dragging a heavy cart is
the way us merchants live.
Then see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
好好享受生活吧。
人生可不只是悶頭趕路...慢慢走，看看四周，拖著沉甸甸的手推車，這才是咱們商人的日子。
那就下回見。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Be healthy~
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
保重身體~

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Nice to see you fellow merchant
If I remember correctly,
you're that famous merchant
these days.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
同行，見到你真高興。
要沒記錯，你就是近來很有名的那個商人吧。

scripts.text:
But your cart doesn't
seem to fit your fame.
How pitiful.
scripts.translation:
可這手推車，似乎配不上你的名氣啊。
真寒磣。

scripts.text: That's why I came here.
scripts.translation: 所以我才來這裡

scripts.text: What about my cart?
scripts.translation: 手推車怎麼了

scripts.text: Two pairs is pitiful?
scripts.translation: 兩對輪子很寒磣嗎

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Haha! Ok, ok!
With the things you brought
I will change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
哈哈!，好好好！
就拿你帶來的東西，給手推車換個樣。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Congratulations.
You can choose a cart
according to your taste.
And now you don't even need
me to help you. All you
need is some SP.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
恭喜！
今後能按喜好挑手推車了，不用再找我，花點SP就行。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Convenient, don't you think?
Oh and one more thing!
Each time you level, you can
have a new different cart
So work hard.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
方便吧？
哦，還有，隨著等級提升，能換的新款手推車也會增加，加油練吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But anyways, it looks very nice on you!
Hahaha! Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
總之，這款可真襯你！
哈哈哈!，祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm... It's true that I
change carts but...
In order to do so, I need
some materials to use.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
嗯...我是能改裝手推車，不過得有材料。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
50 Trunks.
10 Iron.
20 Animal Skins.
I need at least these things
to change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
樹幹50個
鐵10個
動物外皮20個
至少得有這些，才能改裝手推車。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
So come see me when you
have prepared everything.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
所以等你準備好一切再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Oh no, you don't know at all?(changes tone)
A new way to show off a merchant's ego!
An expression of an excellent brain!
Change Cart is a skill that
makes a merchant stand out!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
哎呀，完全不知道？（換了個語氣）
彰顯商人自我的新方式，聰明頭腦的體現！
改裝手推車，讓商人與眾不同！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
A fun skill that allows you to
use a cart according to your
level with only 40 SP!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
這招很有趣，只消耗40 SP，就能按等級換用不同的手推車！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
That is Change Cart!
A basic skill for any merchant.
I'll teach you how to make
one so watch carefully, and
do exactly what I do to make
your own in the future!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
這就是改裝手推車，商人的基本本領。
我會示範，仔細看，照著做，以後就能自己改了！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But, since it's the first time
you need to prepare some materials.
50 Trunks!
10 Iron!
20 Animal skins!
-bring these please!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
不過頭一回，得先備點材料：
樹幹50個
鐵10個
動物外皮20個
請把這些帶來！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
All we have to do is
make one using those materials,
so come back when you are ready.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
拿這些材料做一輛就行，準備好再來，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
...it's not 'CARD'!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
...不是“卡片”！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Welcome young one.
Is selling fun? I am the
merchant Charlron. I have been
doing some research about.
carts recently.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
歡迎啊，年輕人。
生意做得有趣嗎？
我是商人查爾隆，最近正在研究手推車。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Aren't you tired of that cart?
Come to me if you want to
change your cart. I'll do a good job.
But, there are some conditions.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
這手推車看膩了？
想換造型，儘管來找我，保證滿意。
不過得滿足些條件。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I'm a pretty famous merchant,
so I don't really deal with beginners.
Once you are level 30
I may consider establishing
a deal with you.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
我也是有名的商人，不跟新手做生意。
等你到30級，再考慮跟你談。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I am a merchant that
deals with many things, Charlron.
If you ever find anything interesting
come back and try to 
negotiate a deal with me.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
我是查爾隆，什麼都經營些的商人。
找到有趣的東西，就來找我談談生意。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, long time no see!
Ohh, the red marks on your cart.
They must be the marks of 'it'...
Seems like I have taught you the skill correctly!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，好久不見！
哦，手推車上的紅印子，一定是“那個”留下的吧...
看來我這招教得不錯！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
You have blood like mine in you!
Mmm! After all!!
I'm happy! Scratch my back!
Here! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
你跟我流著一樣的血！
嗯，果然！！
真高興，幫我撓撓背！
這兒，快點！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh. You have a firm body
for a merchant. You must be
very good a carrying things!?
Mmm you should be able to learn
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦，身為商人，身子倒很結實，肯定很會搬東西吧？！
嗯，學手推車攻擊應該沒問題！

scripts.text: Hey~ that's why I came.
scripts.translation: 嘿~ 這就是我來找你的原因

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hoho!
Got it! I shall teach you
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
Hoho!！明白了！
我來教你手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，天氣真好！
肯賣力揮舞手推車的人，值得獎勵！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using this amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
好了，手推車攻擊學會了。
用這驚人的破壞力，讓咱們商人揚名天下吧。
Muahahahahaha!!!

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a great day!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thank you very much!
...............Kaah!
Very refreshing! Thank you! Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦，是香蕉汁！
太感謝了！
...Kaah!
真爽口！
謝謝，再見！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You are still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the Banana Juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯？還沒走？
啊，還惦記手推車攻擊呢！
看在香蕉汁的分上，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
教手推車攻擊不難，可得先準備改裝手推車的材料。
需要這些...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
先要鐵20個，加固車身；再用粘稠液體30個，緩衝震動。
然後大概還要蒼蠅翅膀20個、觸手5個？
還有給我喝的葡萄汁2瓶！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
帶這些來吧。
我可沒說只要30個、20個，具體多少得看我狀態！
哈哈哈哈!
等你哦，拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，沒杯清爽的飲料，什麼也幹不了！
至少先拿瓶香蕉汁，再開口談吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，不錯！
好，這就教你...手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，天氣真好！
肯賣力揮舞手推車的人，值得獎勵！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using its amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
好了，手推車攻擊學會了。
用這驚人的破壞力，讓咱們商人揚名天下吧。
Muahahahahaha!!!

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦，是香蕉汁！
太感謝了！
...Kaaah!
真不錯！
謝謝，再見！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯？還沒走？
啊，還惦記手推車攻擊呢！
看在香蕉汁的分上，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
教手推車攻擊不難，可得先準備改裝手推車的材料。
需要這些...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
先要鐵20個，加固車身；再用粘稠液體30個，緩衝震動。
然後大概還要蒼蠅翅膀20個、觸手5個？
還有給我喝的葡萄汁2瓶！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Bring these to me.
But that doesn't mean I want only 30 and 20.
It all depends on my condition!
Just bring me these for now.
Hahahaha!
I'm looking forward to it. Good bye then~
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
帶這些來吧。
不過我可沒說只要30個、20個，具體多少得看我狀態！
先弄來再說。
哈哈哈哈!
等著你，那就再見~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing's free nowadays!
How about trying to start a conversation
by offering a bottle of Banana Juice or something?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，如今哪有白拿的好處！
先拿瓶香蕉汁什麼的來，再開口談吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，不錯！
好，這就教你...手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，天氣真好！
肯賣力揮舞手推車的人，值得獎勵！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using its amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
好了，手推車攻擊學會了。
用這驚人的破壞力，讓咱們商人揚名天下吧。
Muahahahahaha!!!

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's Banana Juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦，是香蕉汁！
太感謝了！
...Kaaah!
真不錯！
謝謝，再見！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯？還沒走？
啊，還惦記手推車攻擊呢！
看在香蕉汁的分上，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
教手推車攻擊不難，可得先準備改裝手推車的材料。
需要這些...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
先要鐵20個，加固車身；再用粘稠液體30個，緩衝震動。
然後大概還要蒼蠅翅膀20個、觸手5個？
還有給我喝的葡萄汁2瓶！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
帶這些來吧。
我可沒說只要30個、20個，具體多少得看我狀態！
哈哈哈哈!
等你哦，拜拜~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，沒杯清爽的飲料，什麼也幹不了！
至少先拿瓶香蕉汁，再開口談吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
... you don't seem to know
about Cart Revolution.
Ok, I'll tell you a story
I've never told anyone before.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
...看來你不知道手推車攻擊。
我講個從沒告訴過別人的故事，仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
我一直研究，手推車還能怎麼用。
試過煮拉麵，甚至拿來跳繩，可都不滿意。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
In despair, I wandered
through the fields with my cart.
After wandering dazed day after day..
I met a very strong monster.
Life was in danger!
Why me - a weaponless, armor-less merchant!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
失望之餘，我拖著手推車，在野外遊蕩。
一連好些天，渾渾噩噩...忽然遇上強大的魔物！
命懸一線！
偏偏我是個沒武器、沒盔甲的商人！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I was scared to death.. thinking
and hoping that this wasn't the
last of me. With little hope left
I tried the last thing possible.
I used my cart to hit the monster!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
我嚇壞了...難道就這樣完了？
抱著最後一線希望，拼命一試，用手推車砸向魔物！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The monster died in one hit.
It was then that I realized something.
Carts can become weapons, too!
I finally realized that we can
attack with carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
一擊就把魔物打死了。
那一刻，我才明白：手推車也能當武器！
原來，還能用它攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Cart Revolution!
That's the new attack skill I developed.
Using 12 SP you lift your cart
to hit your opponent..
right in the head!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
手推車攻擊！
這就是我創出的新攻擊技能。
消耗12 SP，舉起手推車，對著敵人腦袋就砸！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The heavier your cart is, the
stronger you can attack! With one hit,
your opponent will be hurt and
forced to back off!
This is Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
手推車越重，攻擊越強！
一擊就能打傷敵人，逼它後退！
這就是手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm, a young merchant.
You must use carts, too.
Since you need to do business.
But is that all?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，年輕的商人，做生意肯定也用手推車吧。
可它只能拿來做生意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
我一直研究，手推車還能怎麼用。
試過煮拉麵，甚至拿來跳繩，可都不滿意。

scripts.text: I know, I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
...no, what I'm saying is.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
...不是，我想說的是...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Would you like to learn this skill?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
你想學習這個技能嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!!
scripts.translation: 我要學

scripts.text: I want to learn sushi skills...
scripts.translation: 我想學壽司技能...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ok!
I'll give you special training!
First you need health!
Get yourself to merchant
level 35!
We'll talk after that!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
好！給你來個特訓！
先把身子練結實，商人等級到35級了再談！

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Gershaun]
Stupid boy!
It's way to early for you to
even put your hands on sushi!
scripts.translation:
[壽司之王格爾肖恩]
笨男孩！
你連碰壽司的資格都還沒有呢！

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Gershaun]
Stupid girl!
It's way to early for you to
even put your hands on sushi!
scripts.translation:
[壽司之王格爾肖恩]
笨女孩！
你連碰壽司的資格都還沒有呢！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
If it doesn't work, make it work.
If it doesn't work, make it work.
If it doesn't work, make it work.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
不行，就想辦法做到。
不行，就想辦法做到。
不行，就想辦法做到。
